law_name: Law No. 491 of 24 November 1948 on the protection of literary and artistic works (as amended to Law No. 1.313 of 29 June 2006)
term_of_protection: Author's life + 50 years (Art. 12; posthumous and collaborative works 50 years from publication or last author's death)
enforcement_body: Intellectual Property Division, Directorate of Economic Development (Division de la propriete intellectuelle, Direction du Developpement Economique)
notes: Preparatory documents of Law 1.526 of 2022 also state 50 years post mortem; a Mondaq article mentions a planned extension to 70 years, no enacted law found. Two explainer sites claim 70 years (low reliability). WCT/WPPT/TRIPS status not confirmed.
